name: Mimata (Japan)
description: A brown field charged at the centre with the Mimata town emblem in yellow and black: a yellow disc bearing a black stylised device of three leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Mimata, a town in Miyazaki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1954.

features.role: Mimata town emblem — a yellow disc bearing a black stylised device of three leaves
